title: TiDB Cloud agent stack: anti-money-laundering agent (Filesystem + TiDB X + Lake)
tagline: A scripted AML investigator opens a case layer and a database branch per alert, remembers past cases, and learns a better rule in Lake, all on synthetic data.
pattern: Financial services teams asking how an investigation agent can keep case evidence isolated, test rule changes safely, remember past cases and improve over time without touching production data.

metrics.label: Alerts per Minute (accelerated clock)
metrics.howMeasured: New alert rows inserted by one rule-engine tick (affectedRows of the INSERT IGNORE into alerts), scaled by 60000 / AML_TICK_MS. One tick simulates one day of transactions, so this is alerts per wall-clock minute on an accelerated clock, not a production alert rate.

metrics.label: Planted-Pattern Recall
metrics.howMeasured: plantedCoverage over all production alerts and the ground_truth table: planted accounts that have an alert from their own pattern's rule, divided by all planted accounts, times 100. Ground truth is known because the generator planted it.

metrics.label: False Positives per 1,000 Non-Planted Transactions
metrics.howMeasured: Sum over active production rules of false-positive alerts (alert account not planted for that rule's pattern) times 1000, divided by SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions WHERE account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM ground_truth). Measured against planted ground truth, not analyst opinion.

metrics.label: Case Layer and Journal Open Time
metrics.howMeasured: Seconds from the open-investigation control to the case layer, journal and vault grant all existing (openCaseWorkspace in runner/src/live/filesystem.ts), by Date.now() deltas around those calls.

metrics.label: Investigation Branch Create Time
metrics.howMeasured: Seconds from calling branches.create to branches.waitActive resolving. Branch creation is documented to take a few minutes, so this overlaps the layer and recall work instead of blocking it.

metrics.label: Investigation Open Time (layer plus branch)
metrics.howMeasured: Seconds from the open-investigation control until the layer, journal, grant, recall, evidence files and the active branch all exist. Dominated by branch creation.

metrics.label: Hybrid Recall Latency
metrics.howMeasured: timed() around the single hybrid SQL statement from buildHybridRecallSql: a vector CTE and an fts_match_word CTE fused with reciprocal rank fusion, constant 60, top 3, over the episodic_memory table.

metrics.label: Lake Lookback Latency (months of history)
metrics.howMeasured: timed() around the Lake band-peers (or account lookback) query over AML_LOOKBACK_MONTHS months of synthetic transaction history in harbor.txn_history, through the kit's Lake client, including network time.

metrics.label: Starter Export to Lake Visible
metrics.howMeasured: Seconds from kicking the Lake load task (EXECUTE TASK) until SELECT COUNT(*) FROM harbor.txn_history WHERE txn_id <= cutoff reaches the Starter row count for the same cutoff, polled every 5 seconds. Excludes the export job time, which is logged separately.

metrics.label: Rule Change Alert Volume Delta (measured on the branch)
metrics.howMeasured: On the investigation branch: COUNT of v2 structuring alerts minus COUNT of v1 structuring alerts from SELECT rule_version, COUNT(*) FROM alerts WHERE rule_id = 'structuring' GROUP BY rule_version, after the candidate rule v2 and its replayed alerts are written to the branch only. Negative means quieter.

metrics.label: Rule v1 Precision (simulated analyst verdicts)
metrics.howMeasured: Lake query over harbor.flag_log, production scope, structuring v1: confirmed flags divided by all flags, times 100. Verdicts are simulated: a flag is confirmed when its account is planted ground truth for that rule.

metrics.label: Rule v2 Precision (simulated analyst verdicts)
metrics.howMeasured: Same Lake query for scope branch-shadow, structuring v2, the flags the candidate rule would have raised on the branch. Verdicts are simulated from ground truth.

phases.label: Setup
phases.narration: Harbor Mutual is a fictional bank. We seed synthetic customers, a synthetic watchlist and months of transactions into a TiDB Cloud Starter instance, then export the history to Lake through S3.

phases.label: Baseline Traffic
phases.narration: Ordinary traffic keeps flowing and the v1 rules keep raising alerts. Notice how many are false positives against the ground truth we planted.

phases.label: Inject a Pattern
phases.narration: Now we plant a structuring ring, or a name that is close to a new watchlist entry. We know the answer because we planted it.

phases.label: Alert
phases.narration: The rule engine flags it. Every planted case must be flagged, and the demo checks that.

phases.label: Open an Investigation
phases.narration: Each alert gets its own file system layer, a journal, a ten minute vault grant and a copy-on-write database branch. Branch creation takes minutes, so the agent keeps working while it finishes.

phases.label: Recall Similar Cases
phases.narration: The agent recalls similar past cases with one hybrid query, vector plus full text, and looks back through months of history in Lake. Then it writes evidence and a draft into the case layer. Nothing is filed; a human decides.

phases.label: Test a Rule on the Branch
phases.narration: The agent tries a tighter candidate rule on the branch. Production rules and alerts are untouched, and the demo proves it.

phases.label: Analyst Verdict (simulated)
phases.narration: Verdicts here are simulated from the planted ground truth and labeled that way. They stand in for a human analyst.

phases.label: Lake Evaluation
phases.narration: Flags, verdicts and history land in Lake. One query gives precision per rule version, and recall on planted cases.

phases.label: Distill and Commit a Skill
phases.narration: The agent writes what it learned into a skill file inside a layer. A human presses promote, and only then does the layer commit to the shared skills folder.

phases.label: Lesson to Memory
phases.narration: The lesson goes into episodic memory, so the next similar case recalls it. The journal hash chain then verifies the whole investigation.

checks.label: Every Planted Case Flagged
checks.description: Every account in ground_truth has at least one production alert from the rule for its own pattern.

checks.label: Branch Isolated from Production
checks.description: The candidate rule and its alerts exist on the investigation branch and are absent from the production rules and alerts tables.

checks.label: Case Journal Verifies
checks.description: ti fs-journal verify-journal passes on the case journal after every investigation step was appended.

checks.label: Skill Commit Lands on the Base
checks.description: After commit-layer, reading the skill from the base file system returns exactly the staged text.

checks.label: Lake History Matches the Export
checks.description: Rows in harbor.txn_history up to the export cutoff txn_id equal the Starter row count for the same cutoff.

controls.label: Inject structuring ring
controls.description: Plants a three-account ring of near-threshold cash deposits across branches, with ground truth.

controls.label: Inject watchlist near-match
controls.description: Adds a synthetic watchlist entry whose name is close to an existing customer and rescreens by full-text search.

controls.label: Open investigation
controls.description: Opens a layer, journal, grant and branch for the top open alert and runs the playbook steps.

controls.label: Test rule on branch
controls.description: Writes candidate rule v2 to the branch only, compares alert volume and recall, then records simulated verdicts and runs the Lake evaluation.

controls.label: Promote skill
controls.description: Human approval step: commits the staged skill layer to the base file system and writes the lesson to episodic memory.
